title: never finds transmitter
symptom: The user reports that xDrip never finds the Dexcom G6 transmitter, with logs showing DexTimeKeeper errors about no valid timestamp and rxandroidble2 status 8 (insufficient authorization or GATT connection timeout). The issue occurs on a Samsung Galaxy A5 2017 running LineageOS 17.1 (Android 10).
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. One commenter suggests that Android version 10 might not accept xDrip+, but another maintainer notes that xDrip found the transmitter but had authentication/pairing issues, possibly related to LineageOS.
evidence_quote: xDrip indeed found the transmitter but has some authentication/paring issues.
